title: Count Zeros and Ones in Binary Array

content.problemStatement: Complete the code snippet below to count the number of 0s and 1s in an array that are in random order. You may assume that the array consists of only 0s and 1s.

sampleTestCases.explanation: Input produces the expected output following problem rules.
Input produces the expected output following problem rules.

solution.approach: Count occurrences of 0 and 1 in array.

code.Python3:
import sys
def main():
    toks = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not toks: return
    n = int(toks[0])
    arr = [int(x) for x in toks[1:n+1]]
    print(f"0:{arr.count(0)}\n1:{arr.count(1)}")
if __name__ == "__main__": main()

solution.editorial: Iterate through elements, count 0s and 1s, output 0:count0\n1:count1.
